fichas.title: Brick and Block Masonry: Wall Types and Perimeter Ties
fichas.summary: Introduces load-bearing, bracing, and non-load-bearing masonry walls, and explains the role of perimeter ties in transferring horizontal forces. The page also illustrates a two-leaf cavity wall and a plinth connection.
uses: Brace the building against horizontal loads such as wind

fichas.title: Permissible Chases and Cut-outs in Load-bearing Walls
fichas.summary: Explains that chases and cut-outs may be mechanically formed or built into the bond, and that some cases require structural verification. A table gives permissible dimensions and minimum separations for horizontal and inclined chases, later-cut vertical chases, and chases in bonded masonry.

fichas.title: Masonry Construction Details and Lintels
fichas.summary: Illustrates reinforced aerated-concrete blockwork, masonry door and window lintels, glued blockwork, clay bricks, hollow-block lintels, and insulated block systems.
